decision_rule: Treat archetypes as signals, not commitments. Solve the next damage, defense, AoE, and scaling checks before adding narrow synergy pieces.

strengths: Defense and scaling can share the same debuff actions
failure_modes: A 2-energy setup power can lose short fights
Low debuff density makes the power inert

strengths: Natural overlap between defense and a scaling finisher
Osty can preserve effective Block and contribute damage
failure_modes: Enemy pressure can keep Osty at 1 HP
Bone Shards and other sacrifice lines conflict with preserving a large Osty

strengths: Can replay a small set of high-value cards
failure_modes: Narrow pieces are weak before draw and Soul generation are online
Over-drafting engine pieces can fail immediate fights

strengths: Lets expensive or repeatable cards define the win condition later
failure_modes: Energy without draw or useful sinks does nothing
Friendship has a real Strength opportunity cost
